subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: Should local avatar failures keep generic direct-route 404s while improving authenticated UI diagnostics, or should `/avatar/{agentId}` expose more specific failure statuses for oversized, missing, or rejected files?
rationale: The remaining behavior sits on an authenticated local workspace file-serving path, where more specific endpoint errors improve UX but can change information-disclosure boundaries.

options.title: Improve UI Diagnostics Only
options.body: Keep direct image fetches generic and use the existing metadata reason plus Quick Settings/chat surfaces to show clear oversized or missing-file guidance.

options.title: Expose Endpoint Errors
options.body: Return more specific statuses such as 413 or 400 from the direct avatar route after explicit security review and redaction tests.

options.title: Fold Into Remote Avatar Contract
options.body: Defer local diagnostics into the broader Control UI avatar contract tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/41201.

recommendation.title: Improve UI Diagnostics Only
recommendation.body: Keep direct image fetches generic and use the existing metadata reason plus Quick Settings/chat surfaces to show clear oversized or missing-file guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest combined history across avatar support, size-limit hardening, and Control UI local-file serving.
